verdict.rationale: MCP client support is a fair question for a voice-agent framework, so the axis applies. The pack never documents Pipecat agents connecting to MCP servers as tool sources. The only MCP mention is the context-hub CLI registering itself as an MCP server for a coding agent, which is the opposite role and does not count here. Flows function calling is an adjacent feature, not MCP tool ingestion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
